2026_04_NYJ_CHI.headline: Fitzpatrick’s return strengthens New York as Chicago sorts out quarterback and protection questions
2026_04_NYJ_CHI.paragraph1: New York’s defense is set to regain safety Minkah Fitzpatrick after he returned to full practice, but the Jets are monitoring Breece Hall and several offensive contributors who missed Thursday work. Chicago still has uncertainty at quarterback with Caleb Williams sidelined and Case Keenum and Tyson Bagent practicing, while left tackle Braxton Jones is dealing with a knee injury. The matchup turns on whether the Bears can protect their passer and stay efficient against a Jets defense getting an important veteran back.

2026_04_TEN_BAL.headline: Baltimore’s leaky defense gets a get-right opportunity against Tennessee’s struggling offense
2026_04_TEN_BAL.paragraph1: Baltimore is 2-1 but still chasing defensive consistency after allowing 415 yards to Dallas and surrendering explosive plays and missed-tackle yardage. Tennessee arrives 0-3 with one of the league’s lowest-scoring offenses, giving Kyle Hamilton and the Ravens defense a chance to tighten their tackling. Baltimore also has interior-line concerns after losing Ethan Pocic to a longer-term injury. The Titans’ opportunity is to attack that disruption and stay patient; Baltimore needs cleaner defense so Lamar Jackson is not asked to rescue another late lead.
